diff --git a/agentic-action/action.yml b/agentic-action/action.yml
index 5765046..3b40548 100644
--- a/agentic-action/action.yml
+++ b/agentic-action/action.yml
@@ -78,11 +78,26 @@ runs:
         "$bin" agentic-review "${args[@]:1}" | tee "$out.log"
         if [[ "$PX1_POST" == "true" ]]; then
           cost="$(grep -m1 '^Spent about' "$out.log" || true)"
-          "$bin" post-github --findings "$out/findings.json" --pr "$PX1_PR" --head "$PX1_HEAD" --footer "$cost"
+          run_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
+          "$bin" post-github --findings "$out/findings.json" --pr "$PX1_PR" --head "$PX1_HEAD" \
+            --footer "$cost Full report and trace: download the px1-review artifact from [this run]($run_url) and open report/index.html."
         fi
+        echo "PX1_OUT=$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
         {
           echo "### px1 review"
           echo '```'
           sed -n '/=== Result ===/,/^Report:/p' "$out.log" | sed '$d'
           echo '```'
         } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-/dev/null}"
+
+    - name: Upload the report
+      if: always() && env.PX1_OUT != ''
+      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+      with:
+        name: px1-review
+        path: |
+          ${{ env.PX1_OUT }}/report
+          ${{ env.PX1_OUT }}/findings.json
+          ${{ env.PX1_OUT }}/trace.json
+        retention-days: 14
+        if-no-files-found: ignore

lines.text: --footer "$cost Full report and trace: download the px1-review artifact from [this run]($run_url) and open report/index.html."

+## The report
+
+Each run uploads a `px1-review` artifact (the HTML report, `findings.json`, `trace.json`; kept 14 days) and the summary comment links to the run. Download it and open `report/index.html`. It contains your code and is visible to anyone who can read the repository's Actions runs. The `private/` folder with raw model transcripts is never uploaded.
+
 ## Safety
 
 - Runs on `pull_request`, never `pull_request_target`. Pull requests from forks are skipped: they get no secrets and a read-only token.

blocks.title: Action changes
blocks.summary: 2 related files share the "action" change signal.

explanations.title: PR comments link to the report
explanations.summary: When GitHub posting is enabled, the PR comment now links to the workflow run and tells reviewers where to find the full report in its artifact.

explanations.title: Reports are saved as workflow artifacts
explanations.summary: The action uploads the HTML report, findings, and trace as a `px1-review` artifact when output exists. The artifact is kept for 14 days; missing files are ignored.

explanations.title: Documents report visibility and exclusions
explanations.summary: The documentation clarifies that people with access to repository Actions runs can see the uploaded report, and that raw model transcripts in `private/` are not included.
